# BoltProof
> BoltProof helps UAE businesses design and run private AI on their own data — safely, on infrastructure they control. We are a consultancy: we assess your workflows, set up a private AI system on whatever hardware you have or need, build the AI workflows, and keep it running. Hardware is never the product. Built with open local models (Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, Tailscale) on Apple Silicon or any hardware the customer already runs. Pricing is value-based: a free assessment, then a fixed-fee proposal — no hourly rates, no published price list. Contact: WhatsApp +971 58 510 9454. Set up on site in Dubai and the UAE; supported remotely worldwide.

## Core pages
- [How we work](https://boltproof.com/packages.html): the consultancy — assess, set up, care
- [Book an assessment](https://boltproof.com/configurator.html): tell us about your business, we reply with a written recommendation and fixed-fee proposal
- [AI Workflows](https://boltproof.com/automation.html): email triage, lead capture, scheduling, customer replies, internal dashboards — priced per workflow
- [Security & Hardening](https://boltproof.com/security.html): the 12-point hardening checklist, network architecture, remote access and backup model
- [Local AI vs frontier AI](https://boltproof.com/local-vs-frontier-ai.html): when local models are enough and when a public AI subscription is the simpler choice
- [Industries](https://boltproof.com/industries.html): clinics, accountants, real estate, retail, consultants and agencies
- [Best AI setup for a UAE small team](https://boltproof.com/guides/best-ai-setup-uae-small-business.html): buyer's guide including PDPL
- [Demo and setup](https://boltproof.com/demo.html): architecture, day-one screens, technical FAQ
- [Support](https://boltproof.com/support.html): Warranty and support
- [Blog](https://boltproof.com/blog/)

## Facts
- Hardware-agnostic: works with Apple Silicon, a PC, or servers the customer already runs
- Software: Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, RAG document Q&A, Tailscale
- The AI runs on-site. Staff connect through a private encrypted network (Tailscale), with remote support available when configured
- External AI services are used only where a customer explicitly opts in and configures their own API key — not by default
- Engagements are fixed-fee proposals in AED, exclusive of VAT
